name: Wake Up Blu Q — Captain
source: KB: haldo-kb-harvest §1A Wake Up — Captain; 4.1 Waking up and Putting Blu Q to Bed; Blu Q Daily Log Book
intro: Morning startup checklist for Blu Q. Check weather, tides, and wind for reefing before arriving. Pump out is daily — tank is tiny. Communicate with crew on fuel status and trip plan.

items.label: Pump out boat (gloves under steps)

help.title: Pump out details
help.body: Pump out needs to be done every day — the holding tank is tiny. Gloves are stored under the steps.

items.label: Check fuel and fuel up if necessary
Check oil level
Check secondary fuel filter for water in fuel — ensure red disc at bottom

help.title: Fuel disc check
help.body: Look at the secondary fuel filter. The red disc should be visible at the bottom, confirming no water in the fuel. If disc is not at bottom or water is visible, the fuel filter needs attention.

items.label: Hulls clear of water
Pull in boat for boarding with black stern line and breast line
Strike overnight lines — starboard bow and stern lines

help.title: Overnight lines
help.body: The overnight lines are the starboard bow line and stern line. Strike (remove) them to prepare for departure. The black stern line and breast line are used for boarding position.

items.label: Turn on switches on 12v panel in helm
Bilge pumps set to auto and working
Run bilge pumps for a little
Start engines, cycle through gears
Check maintenance calendar for what is to be done today
Check DMT (daily maintenance task)
items.info: Your DMT checklist shows today's specific task. Complete it separately — this checkbox confirms you're aware of it.

items.label: Rig centered, boom not on bimini
Clear covers off helm and sailbag
Check tides and wind for reefing
Muster with crew for training, weather and plan the trip, reef sail if needed
Verify head is super clean
Snorkel and kayak gear checked
Check rez software for roster, waivers, trip notes
Music set to Honest Eco Playlist — NO commercials
Boat ready for boarding 30 minutes prior to departure
As guests arrive, say hello, relay boarding time, offer shore head

completion.notes_prompt: Any issues found during startup? Anything to flag for the deckhand or next captain?
